text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a peek inside the dance studio
and find
Tokai Teio practicing on her
own.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right! Here's my revised Teio Step!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Huh? Uh-oh! Whoooa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gets thrown off balance mid-spin
and falls
over.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, ow.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're here?! You should've said

something sooner!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're not interrupting! I wanted to
show you
anyways!
choice_data_list: 邪魔したくなかったから

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You saw some of it, right? My revised
Teio
Step! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
For the last part, I lift one foot and spin
around!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's super cool when I get it right, but
keeping the
momentum going is the
tricky part.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you're right! I always get dizzy
halfway
through.
choice_data_list: バランス感覚を鍛えよう
全身の筋力をつけよう

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Oh I know! I could take ballet lessons
from
Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Isn't her dad a professional ballet
dancer? I'm
sure she'll know a good way
to practice!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ Everyone's eyes will be glued
to the
great Teio's amazing dance!
choice_data_list: 完成、楽しみにしてるよ

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh! I did improve my balance, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I think taking that drive with Maruzen
afterwards
did way more in teaching me
how to keep my
balance...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected bonus lesson seems to
have tired
her out, but at least it was
productive.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
True. I'm gonna need strength if I don't
wanna get
all wobbly!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll do some weight training so I
can
finish my revised Teio Step!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Do you know a good routine for building
muscle
all around?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I nod.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, we both do some weight
training.
